integrations.intro: This page shows how Cornerstone is connected. You can't change these settings here: they are set when Cornerstone starts. To change one, edit its environment variable and restart Cornerstone.

setup.heading: How to set it up

loadError.heading: Couldn't load the integrations

paperless.title: Paperless
paperless.purpose: Link invoices and other records to documents stored in Paperless.
paperless.hint: Add the address and an access token from Paperless, then restart Cornerstone.
paperless.unreachable: Cornerstone can't connect to Paperless right now. Linked documents show as numbers until it is back. Check that the address is right and that Paperless is running.
paperless.tagNotFound: Cornerstone can't find the filter tag “{{tag}}” in Paperless, so no documents are shown until the tag exists.

ai.title: AI
ai.purpose: Reads documents and helps write report text. Reading documents also needs Paperless.
ai.hint: Add the address, a key and a model name from your AI provider, then restart Cornerstone.

singleSignOn.title: Single sign-on
singleSignOn.purpose: Let people sign in with an outside login service instead of a password.
singleSignOn.hint: Register the redirect address below with your login service, then add its details and restart Cornerstone.
singleSignOn.newAccountsLinkOnly: Only people who already have an account

calendarContacts.title: Calendar & contacts sync
calendarContacts.purpose: Each person connects a calendar or contacts app with a personal token.
calendarContacts.hint: Nothing to set up here. Each person creates a token in Account.

automaticBackups.title: Automatic backups
automaticBackups.purpose: Saves a backup of your project on a schedule.
automaticBackups.hint: Set a schedule to turn automatic backups on, then restart Cornerstone.
automaticBackups.invalidSchedule: This schedule isn't valid, so automatic backups are off.
automaticBackups.noRunsYet: No automatic backups have run yet

history.title: History
history.purpose: Records changes to your project automatically in History.
history.hint: History is always on. It can't be turned off.

money.title: Currency & VAT
money.purpose: Sets the currency and the VAT rate used for amounts.
money.hint: Change the currency or the VAT rate, then restart Cornerstone.

photos.title: Photo storage
photos.purpose: Where photos are kept and how large one photo can be.
photos.hint: Change the folder or the size limit, then restart Cornerstone.

publicAddress.title: Public address and proxy
publicAddress.purpose: The web address people use, and how Cornerstone trusts a proxy in front of it.
publicAddress.hint: Set the public address if Cornerstone sits behind a proxy, then restart Cornerstone.
publicAddress.notSet: Not set. Cornerstone uses the address in your browser.
